desc: Read inputs K, S, and T from stdin.
Check if `abs(len(S) - len(T)) > K`; if so, print "No" and exit.
Initialize a DP array (or two rows) to store edit distances, capped at K+1.
Iterate through each character of S, updating the DP table for the relevant window of T indices (within K of the current S index).
After filling the DP table, check if the value at `dp[|S|][|T|]` is <= K.
Print "Yes" if the edit distance is <= K, otherwise print "No".

Implement the banded DP approach. Initialize a DP table (or two rows for space optimization) with size `(len(S)+1) x (2*K+1)` or similar, mapping the band. Iterate through `i` from 0 to `len(S)`. For each `i`, iterate `j` from `max(0, i-K)` to `min(len(T), i+K)`. Compute `dp[i][j]` using the standard recurrence: If `S[i-1] == T[j-1]`: `dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]` Else: `dp[i][j] = 1 + min(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1], dp[i-1][j-1])`. Cap values at `K+1`. After filling the table, check if `dp[len(S)][|T|] <= K`. Print "Yes" or "No".
